$comment: MCP manifest. The transport is JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST, matching what /api/mcp actually speaks. Copy this into a client's MCP configuration to let an agent call the frost tools.

frostwatch.notes: Send {jsonrpc:'2.0', id, method, params} as a JSON POST body. Mutating tools are scoped to the caller's anonymous session cookie, so include the session cookie if you want to read back what you created.
